name: OTel-Embedding-22M
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.023 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-02-02. CAVEATS: Single row: NDCG@10 on a held-out 10% partition of the authors' own OTel-Embedding telecom dataset. The card states the aggregate does not guarantee subdomain performance and that this is not an external benchmark. 22M params, all-MiniLM-L6-v2 base. Delta +59.7pp is large because the base has no telecom training at all.

benchmarks.name: OTel telecom retrieval NDCG@10
benchmarks.config: Card table 'OTel vs. Base Model': base model 24.1% vs OTel fine-tuned 83.8% +/- 0.8, delta +59.7 pp, OTel-Embedding held-out 10% split, bootstrap n=1000. Held-out OTel partition only, not an external benchmark.
